title: Each challenge prize the owner gives sends its own winner message, so from the 3rd winner there is no pop-up and the prizes use up the day's 10 messages
what: Since the owner now gives each winner’s free days one by one, every give writes a separate "You won the gym challenge" message. From the third one of the day the winner gets no phone pop-up, and every one counts towards the gym’s 10 messages a day, so an owner who gives 8 prizes can send only 2 of their own messages that day, and 10 prizes block all of them. The server notes still say a challenge sends at most two messages.
expected: Every winner gets a pop-up for their prize, and prize messages do not use up the owner’s daily message allowance (or the owner is told before giving).
who: members who win a challenge, and owners
how_often: every challenge with 3 or more winners given on one day
fix_line: Leave prize messages out of the daily count and the no-pop-up rule, or send one message per challenge

title: Tapping the pop-up for a pause or renew answer, a report request or a workout offer opens the shop, not the card it is about
what: These pop-ups open the Gym tab. When the gym has its shop turned on, the Gym tab opens on its Shop part (the products), and the membership card with the answer, the yes or no for the report, and the offer card sit in another part the member must find by hand. For a report request the pop-up says "Open the app to say yes or no", but the tap shows products.
expected: A tap opens the exact card it names: the membership card for a pause, renewal or report request, the offer card for an offer.
who: members of gyms with the shop turned on
fix_line: Give these pop-ups a route that opens the Gym part of the tab at the right card

items.reason: Server-written words: challenge winner messages, plan answer, report request and order pop-ups, the friend enquiry line, name fallbacks. Plain and true for what they cover; error codes are inside words the apps turn into sentences. The member app is English only, so no Hinglish there; the friend enquiry line "Best time to train" is written in English into the gym records and so stays English in a Hinglish admin app (already filed). No banned-word list was given, none checked. Hindi read-aloud list: none needed, the server writes no Hindi.
server change files hold no buttons; the limits they enforce (10 a day, one offer a day) are shown by the admin app
no layout in this area; the server only caps lengths (title 60, body 300)
no picture paths in these files; member photos are the gym’s own JPEGs, notification icons are set in the HQ sender and the app
no brand pictures here; the old name forgeai appears only as an inside setting name nobody sees
one tap handler; it opens any plain app path the pop-up names
server kinds: message, offer, trainer reply, plan answer, report request, order, help reply; their pages /shop/inbox, /shop, /shop/ask, /shop/orders, /settings/feedback all exist
no save buttons in this area
HQ functions here write to the HQ record; the nightly backup writes one row naming no gym; the direct-database record lives in a later change file (another area), already filed
